title: Multi-file bug hunt in a cart module
brief: Customers of this small shop module report three problems: (1) cart totals are wrong when a coupon is used, sometimes by a lot and sometimes with fractional dong; (2) stock can go negative; (3) customers cannot buy exactly the maximum allowed quantity on one line. Find and fix the root causes across `src/`. Keep every exported function name and signature. Amounts are integer VND; percentage discounts round half-up to the nearest dong and the coupon applies once to the subtotal. Add regression tests. `npm test` runs the tests.
